description: NTSB aviation accident/incident investigations, by aircraft registration (tail) number or by make/model. Returns NTSB number, event date, location, injury level, phase/occurrence, probable cause, findings, and the NTSB docket link for each match. Registration numbers (N-numbers) are reused over time by different aircraft; pass `year` to narrow a registration match to one incarnation when more than one comes back. A broad make with no `model` or `year` may be asked to narrow — this reads a small sharded dataset, never a full scan. Sourced from the NTSB's own eADMS aviation accident database (data.ntsb.gov/avdata).

registration.description: Aircraft registration / tail number, e.g. "N512SP" (dashes/spacing ignored).

state.description: US state postal abbreviation of the event location, e.g. "CA".

year.description: Limit to events in this calendar year. Required for a common make (e.g. Cessna, Piper) unless `model` is also given.

name: ntsb_search_investigations
title: Ntsb Search Investigations
